roleSummary: A senior frontend engineer who owns a React and TypeScript codebase and its design system, ships accessible and fast UI with Next.js, and mentors other engineers.

dimensions.name: React depth
dimensions.instructions: Judge professional React experience: years in paid roles and complexity of the apps built.

levels.label: None
levels.description: No React mentioned.

levels.label: Basic
levels.description: Tutorials, personal projects or under one year of professional React.

levels.label: Working
levels.description: One to three years building React features in a team.

levels.label: Strong
levels.description: Three to five years; owned complex React apps in production.

levels.label: Expert
levels.description: Five or more years; architected large React codebases used by many engineers.

dimensions.name: TypeScript
dimensions.instructions: Judge hands-on TypeScript use in production code, not just listing it.

levels.label: None
levels.description: No TypeScript mentioned.

levels.label: Basic
levels.description: Listed as a skill without described use.

levels.label: Working
levels.description: Writes typed components and props day to day.

levels.label: Strong
levels.description: Designs shared types and strict configurations for a codebase.

levels.label: Expert
levels.description: Leads TypeScript migrations or authors typed libraries used by others.

dimensions.name: Accessibility
dimensions.instructions: Judge shipped accessibility work: WCAG conformance, audits, keyboard and screen-reader support.

levels.label: None
levels.description: No accessibility work mentioned.

levels.label: Basic
levels.description: Mentions accessibility without concrete work.

levels.label: Working
levels.description: Fixed accessibility issues in shipped features.

levels.label: Strong
levels.description: Brought a product to WCAG AA and kept it there.

levels.label: Expert
levels.description: Led accessibility programmes or audits across several products.

dimensions.name: Design systems
dimensions.instructions: Judge building or maintaining a shared component library or design system.

levels.label: None
levels.description: No component library or design system work.

levels.label: Basic
levels.description: Used a design system built by others.

levels.label: Working
levels.description: Contributed components to a shared library.

levels.label: Strong
levels.description: Owned a design system used by several teams or products.

levels.label: Expert
levels.description: Created a design system from scratch, with tokens, docs and adoption across an organisation.

dimensions.name: Testing discipline
dimensions.instructions: Judge unit and end-to-end testing of frontend code (Jest/Vitest, Testing Library, Playwright, Cypress).

levels.label: None
levels.description: No frontend testing mentioned.

levels.label: Basic
levels.description: Lists testing tools without described practice.

levels.label: Working
levels.description: Writes unit tests for components.

levels.label: Strong
levels.description: Maintains unit and end-to-end suites in CI.

levels.label: Expert
levels.description: Set the testing strategy for a frontend organisation.

mustHaves.statement: The candidate has 5 or more years of professional React experience.
The candidate uses TypeScript in production code.
The candidate has shipped accessible UI (WCAG AA) to production users.

redFlags.statement: The resume lists frontend frameworks or tools that no role description backs up with concrete work.
The candidate has not done frontend work in the last two years.

fit.instructions: Decide how well the candidate fits the role overall.

options.description: Meets every must-have and shows real design-system and testing depth.
Misses one must-have, or depth in design systems or testing is unclear.
Misses several must-haves, or frontend work is superficial.
